purpose: Machine-readable anti-entropy contract for AI-assisted iKant development. It records the audited baseline, open engineering ignorance, modeled stress coverage, supply-chain assumptions, semantic roadmap and iteration handoff protocol. It is control-plane state, not epistemic evidence and not a substitute for executable runtime oracles.
unitary_intent: Consolidate the executable and constitutional truth of iKant before adding user-governable state or external computation; make each new capability causally closed, supply-chain-real, user-legible, falsifiable at its physical boundary and resumable by a fresh chat session without relying on conversational memory.
functioning_definition: one declared source of semantic runtime truth per lifecycle phase
every user mutation has a typed writer, bounded effect, receipt and recovery path
every behavior-changing state is bound to runtime/session/cycle/component identity
UI claims no capability stronger than the concrete technological supply chain can deliver
presentation never widens evidence, permission, approval, grant, lease or execution authority
all material DoD claims are exercised at the same browser/OS/provider boundary they name
merge and development history are traceable independently of model-generated prose

audit_findings.finding: After a successful /api/v10/surface bind, S16 browser reads can still silently fall back to independent legacy semantic endpoints when the canonical snapshot fails.
audit_findings.risk: split semantic realities can reappear exactly when the canonical contract is unavailable
audit_findings.candidate_mitigation: S16bis fail-closed browser boundary after first canonical ACTIVE bind

audit_findings.finding: PR47 was a material S15bis runtime slice but PRODUCT_CONTRACT lineage currently jumps S15 -> S16 although future_slice_rule explicitly requires material bis slices to be registered.
audit_findings.risk: Product Boundary can be self-consistent while incomplete against actual Git development history
audit_findings.candidate_mitigation: retrospective S15bis lineage reconciliation plus Git/contract provenance oracle

audit_findings.finding: main is not protected and required status checks are not enforced by repository branch protection.
audit_findings.risk: CI receipts are advisory rather than a material merge barrier
audit_findings.candidate_mitigation: repository ruleset/branch protection requiring Hosted, Reticular, Product Boundary and current real-browser gate

audit_findings.finding: S16 all-and-only manifest test compares surface_manifest against a hardcoded expected set rather than independently enumerating the production UI/API control census.
audit_findings.risk: manifest and test can agree while an undeclared control or read path exists
audit_findings.candidate_mitigation: production-derived surface census oracle across composed assets, routes and browser DOM

audit_findings.finding: The canonical S16 snapshot is ACTIVE-only while admission/setup remain legacy-bootstrap surfaces, but the manifest includes admission_lifecycle without making the lifecycle scope explicit.
audit_findings.risk: single-surface wording can be interpreted more broadly than the implemented boundary
audit_findings.candidate_mitigation: declare and test PRE_ACTIVE_BOOTSTRAP -> ACTIVE_CANONICAL transition contract

audit_findings.finding: Stable Surface Contract cache and S15 WorkStore are process-local; restart can lose the last stable overlay/work projection while canonical frame state may remain recoverable elsewhere.
audit_findings.risk: restart/replay can produce truthful-but-incomplete or inconsistent work presentation
audit_findings.candidate_mitigation: durable session-bound stable checkpoint plus canonical pending-frame/work reconciliation

audit_findings.finding: S16 config-effect receipt uses a recomputable SHA-256 checksum stored with the payload.
audit_findings.risk: detects accidental corruption but is not an authenticity proof against a writer able to rewrite the file
audit_findings.candidate_mitigation: classify it as integrity checksum or bind to an append-only/runtime-authenticated receipt chain

audit_findings.finding: forget_memory marks one node FORGOTTEN but does not use the dependency cascade implemented for source revocation.
audit_findings.risk: a user-facing Forget action could suppress a source while dependent derived memories remain cognitively available
audit_findings.candidate_mitigation: define forget semantics and dependency-closure before exposing mutation UI

audit_findings.finding: TemporalAutonomy is durable locally but schedule/journal ownership is session-bound and no current UI contract establishes OS-background residency across app shutdown/reboot.
audit_findings.risk: a reminder UI could promise wake behavior the process supply chain cannot deliver
audit_findings.candidate_mitigation: runtime-epoch ownership plus explicit residency guarantee; native background host only in a later capability slice if required

audit_findings.finding: S15 build_graph/command_plan is a separate representation from the existing canonical practical_reason -> planning -> execution_protocol lattice.
audit_findings.risk: directly binding S15 plans would create competing plan semantics and authority confusion
audit_findings.candidate_mitigation: typed IntentEnvelope and reconciliation into the existing canonical plan ledger, never a second planner

audit_findings.finding: Commercial assist still relies on default redirect-following transport and its provider response parsers do not uniformly reject every non-text/tool-bearing output shape.
audit_findings.risk: credential/endpoint boundary and tool prohibition are not strong enough for activation
audit_findings.candidate_mitigation: reject redirects, pin effective provider origin, fail closed on unknown output items, keep feature disabled until provider-bound E2E passes

audit_findings.finding: S16 real HTTP test uses a synthetic slow service and S16-specific Chromium assertions were not added; the inherited browser oracle proves S15bis liveness, not the entire S16 semantic virtualizer.
audit_findings.risk: browser-specific cache/fallback/controller failures can escape Python HTTP tests
audit_findings.candidate_mitigation: real Chromium S16bis canonical-read failure/recovery and DOM census oracle

audit_findings.finding: Invariant extension currently snapshots the previous registry in invariants_legacy_s15.py; repeating this pattern each slice would accumulate copied constitutional code.
audit_findings.risk: lineage code duplication and stale registry behavior
audit_findings.candidate_mitigation: future modular invariant ownership registry rather than per-slice whole-file snapshots

bootstrap_steps: Obey AGENTS.md admission/rights boundary before repository study or materialization.
Fetch current main SHA, current open/draft PRs and exact current Product Contract.
Read AGENTS.md, PRODUCT_CONTRACT.json, IKANT_DEVELOPMENT_BUNDLE.json and files/tests/docs owned by the current candidate slice.
Run python scripts/development_bundle_gate.py. If baseline/current contract drift is detected, select ANTI_ENTROPY_REVIEW before development.
Re-evaluate all OPEN CRITICAL/HIGH findings affected by current main; never silently mark a finding closed from prose or modeled mutation counts.
Select the smallest semantic slice whose prerequisites are closed and whose supply chain can be materially exercised.

modes.DEVELOP: Materialize the next minimal runtime slice with atomic semantic commits, local/CI/physical-boundary oracles and an exact-head draft PR.
modes.ANTI_ENTROPY_REVIEW: Re-audit main + current PR, rerun declared stress models, challenge roadmap/prerequisites/DoD and update the bundle before adding capability.
modes.HANDOFF: Freeze the current engineering state into the bundle, make its gate pass structurally, record exact branch/PR/SHA/check receipts and prepare a fresh chat session to resume from files rather than conversation memory.

end_of_iteration_steps: record changed facts and unresolved ignorance in the bundle/backlog
separate modeled evidence from executable unit/HTTP/browser/OS/provider evidence
open/update draft PR and record exact head/synthetic-merge status without inventing PASS
run bundle gate and state whether ready_to_advance is true
ask the human to choose DEVELOP, ANTI_ENTROPY_REVIEW or HANDOFF
